Recompute recognized diagnostics with published unit-specific tolerances; route unsupported alternative methods/windows/sampling to NOT_VERIFIED/manual review rather than candidate FAIL.
scientific_adjudication: The previously approved scientific PASS for job 3968344 is unchanged; this record changes only method-neutral verifier treatment and does not authorize another simulation.
numerical_tolerance_basis: The previous 1e-9 comparison tolerance was not specified by the frozen contract and is tighter than the representations being checked. GROMACS XVG values are decimal-rounded; GRO coordinates are quantized to 0.001 nm, with propagated uncertainty in derived distances and angles. The explicit unit-specific tolerances in output-contract.json reflect those representations and preserve materially meaningful discrepancy detection.
